body: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original 2994 salvage racing videogame eight-angle car BODY SHELL sprite sheet. Muted petrol teal paint with worn copper repair patches and charcoal lower cladding, scratched salvaged hand-painted realistic game illustration matching reference. EXACT eight views in four columns and two rows: top row straight FRONT, front-quarter nose pointing LEFT, full side nose LEFT, rear-quarter nose RIGHT; bottom row straight REAR, rear-quarter nose LEFT, full side nose RIGHT, front-quarter nose RIGHT. Crucially NO wheels, tires, rims, brake discs or suspension: wheel arches are genuine transparent empty cutouts completely open below, runtime adds wheels. Genuine transparent background all around each shell and inside wheel wells, no shadows, no checkerboard pixels. Opaque dark windows. No labels, no ground, no scenery.
